failure.stage: paired Qwen inference before reference loading

root_cause: The runner recomputed the 32-frame index with Python round(), while the frozen anchor manifest already contained the authoritative source_frame_index. Some recomputed indices differed by one frame.
replacement: Read source_frame_index directly from each frozen evidence anchor and validate that it is inside the source video.
fairness_effect: The replacement restores the preregistered same-anchor invariant for both arms. It does not change trigger questions, MMR8 A0, OCR, ASR, answer prompt, model, view count, image size, visual tokens, decoding, or candidate layout bytes.
